description: This file contains functions for handling and verifying JWT tokens including signature verification, token validation, and public key management, primarily used for authentication with Azure AD.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Main function to verify a JWT token's integrity and validity.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of the JWT token using the public key.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the key file modification time is within a 4-hour window.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Validates the token's payload data such as timestamp claims and tenant ID.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes the public key to a file for use in signature verification.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token-related information and errors to a log file.

methods.name: base64decode_url
methods.description: Decodes base64 URL-encoded strings, handling padding and URL-safe characters.
